verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB is a managed ClickHouse warehouse service, so first-party notebooks are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence documents only external BI/SQL tool connectivity (Grafana, Metabase, Superset, etc.), MCP access for coding agents, and monitoring views. None of that is a first-party notebook mixing SQL and Python with inline results and charts, and connecting third-party tools does not count toward this story.
